source_text: In every thing give thanks: for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus concerning you.
child_paraphrase: Give thanks in every part of your day. This is what God wants for you in Jesus.
license_note: Short quotation of the 1769 Oxford King James Version. That edition is public domain in the United States. No bulk copyrighted Bible text is used.
lock_note: Issue #6 Mission 8 lock: The Thankful Table.
forbidden_claims: Do not invent extra narrative as scripture
Do not treat dinner tables, candles, or other meal props as facts from this verse
Do not add verses, names, or events that are not in 1 Thessalonians 5:18
